reason: Document A owns the reason for the silence without excuses, sets a concrete date for the next update, and offers a realistic, unvarnished look at both the churn risk ($3,800 MRR exposed) and the modest initial impact of the new product ($900 MRR). That level of candor and accountability actually rebuilds my trust enough to take the 20-minute call, whereas Document B feels generic and leaves unedited template placeholders.
